label: copy-phase fed-back "d" (recall position >= 3), esp. when next output is x/v/d/i/s/l/n/w
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost exclusively (99% of mass) when the fed-back input token is "d" (a few weak hits on x/v inputs). Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, and never on a first occurrence of a token. Input d in copy phase alone has recall 0.97 but precision 0.17: the feature is gated further by (a) position: rate rises sharply from recall_idx 3 onward (peak at 4), near zero at recall_idx 1-2; and (b) the token being output next (the original token following d): highest for x, v, d, then i, s, l, n, w; weak for other tokens. Conjunction gives dev F1 0.66, mass recall 0.79. Remaining false positives are d inputs with those outputs that stay silent for no clear reason; misses are d inputs followed by other tokens (lower magnitude). Magnitude is largest at recall_idx 3-4 with output x/v/d.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: d, x, v, w, -, s; least: g, k, 0, z) and the token being output (most: x, d, v, i, s, n; least: -, z, j, g); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3, recall_idx=5.
